post.description: Stores the PERSISTENT configuration for an agent: webhook URL (call_back_url) and bearer token (api_token) reused by default for all of its calls. These values can be overridden on a single call by passing them directly to /leads/v3/phone-call (per-call override, not persisted). With no config here and no per-call value, no webhook is delivered.

api_token.description: Optional. Bearer token sent in the webhook Authorization header (so your endpoint can authenticate Sairen). If omitted, the token configured via POST /config/setup is used.

retry_attempts.description: Optional. Number of call attempts. Per-call, otherwise the value configured via /config/setup, otherwise defaults to 3.

first_retry_delay.description: Optional. Delay (in seconds) before the first retry. Per-call, otherwise defaults to 600.

retry_delay.description: Optional. Delay (in seconds) between subsequent retries. Per-call, otherwise the value configured via /config/setup, otherwise defaults to 3600.
